mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERSON_LIKE ( MEMBER_ID, PERSON_ID, CREATED_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{personId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT MEMBER_ID, PERSON_ID, CREATED_DT, EXTERNAL_ID, NAME_KO, NAME_ORG, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, ROLE, LATEST_CONTENT_TITLE FROM ( SELECT PL.MEMBER_ID, PL.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(PL.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, P.EXTERNAL_ID, P.NAME_KO, P.NAME_ORG, P.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_CREDIT ROLE_CC WHERE ROLE_CC.PERSON_ID = P.PERSON_ID AND ROLE_CC.ROLE = 'DIRECTOR' ) THEN 'DIRECTOR' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_CREDIT ROLE_CC WHERE ROLE_CC.PERSON_ID = P.PERSON_ID ) THEN 'ACTOR' END AS ROLE, LC.LATEST_CONTENT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY PL.CREATED_DT DESC, PL.MEMBER_ID DESC, PL.PERSON_ID DESC ) AS RNUM FROM PERSON_LIKE PL JOIN PERSON P ON P.PERSON_ID = PL.PERSON_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PERSON_ID, LATEST_CONTENT_TITLE FROM ( SELECT CC.PERSON_ID, NVL(C.TITLE_KO, C.TITLE_ORG) AS LATEST_CONTENT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CC.PERSON_ID ORDER BY C.RELEASE_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST, CC.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, CC.CONTENT_ID ASC, CC.CREDIT_ID ASC ) AS CONTENT_RNUM FROM CONTENT_CREDIT CC JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_ID = CC.CONTENT_ID ) WHERE CONTENT_RNUM = 1 ) LC ON LC.PERSON_ID = P.PERSON_ID
)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize})
ORDER BY RNUM

SELECT PERSON_ID, EXTERNAL_ID, NAME_KO, NAME_ORG, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM ( SELECT P.PERSON_ID, P.EXTERNAL_ID, P.NAME_KO, P.NAME_ORG, P.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY PC.LIKE_COUNT DESC, PC.LATEST_LIKED_DT DESC, P.PERSON_ID ASC ) AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT PERSON_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT, MAX(CREATED_DT) AS LATEST_LIKED_DT FROM PERSON_LIKE GROUP BY PERSON_ID ) PC JOIN PERSON P ON P.PERSON_ID = PC.PERSON_ID ) WHERE RNUM <= #{size} ORDER BY RNUM
